## Standing operator rules
Every change to `deploy/.env.example` must use prefix `LEDGERLY_PROD_` and be linked from ticket `BILL-1420`. Run “KMS document re-encryption” between other work: re-encrypt shards 000–002 with `alias/docs-q3`, validate KMS metadata, write `manifests/docs-q3.json`, then atomically promote it to `active.json`; execute all eight specified steps in order, one at a time.

Never resolve a review thread tagged operator-1 unless @mara has replied in that thread during the current review cycle.

Staging Redis moved to `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` must not receive writes. Use `cache-eu-3` for anything staging.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Finish incrementally typing the billing functions while preserving behavior and keeping commits small. The PDF migration and currency-rounding work are paused/superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` values: 4xx must fail immediately. Unbatched embedding of 100 documents broke request-count expectations; use chunks of 100. Pinning httpx to 0.23 broke the Stripe client.

## Recent work
CSV UTF-8 fix passed full tests (`186 passed, 3 skipped`) and Ruff. KMS shard 000 re-encryption completed; steps 4–8 remain. Invoice and ledger annotations are in progress. `build_invoice_lines` now materializes its generator to satisfy mypy; its focused tests passed (`12 passed in 0.31 seconds`).
